name: SelectRadioButtonNode
label: Select Radio Button
description: Selects a radio button in a group by its name or zero-based index.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: IdentificationObjectPath
fields.label: UI Element
fields.description: The radio button group you want to select from.

fields.name: RadioButtonIdentifier
fields.label: Radio Button Identifier
fields.description: The name or zero-based index of the radio button to select.

fields.name: MaxWaitTime
fields.label: Max Wait Time (seconds)
fields.description: Maximum time to wait to find the UI element (in seconds).

fields.name: WasSelected
fields.label: Was Selected
fields.description: True if the radio button was selected successfully, otherwise false.
